appName.description: Extension name. Brand name, kept identical in every language.

appDescription.message: Automatically saves STL, 3MF and ZIP files from MakerWorld, Printables and Thingiverse into sorted subfolders.
appDescription.description: Short description shown in the Chrome Web Store. Limit: 132 characters.

statusLabel.description: Popup: label of the status row.

statusActive.description: Popup: badge shown while the extension is working.

statusPaused.description: Popup: badge shown while the extension is paused.

pauseButton.description: Popup: button that pauses the extension.

resumeButton.description: Popup: button that resumes the extension.

pauseHint.message: Downloads are ignored until the browser is restarted.

debugLabel.description: Popup: label of the debug toggle.

debugHint.message: Shows detailed logs in the browser console (F12). Reload the page to activate.
debugHint.description: Popup: explanation shown while debug mode is on.

howToTitle.description: Popup: heading of the short usage guide.

howToText.message: Download a model the way you always do. The files land sorted in:
howToText.description: Popup: first line of the usage guide, followed by the target path.

howToIcon.message: Green icon = supported site (Thingiverse, MakerWorld, Printables).
howToIcon.description: Popup: explains what the green toolbar icon means.

notifySuccessTitle.description: Notification title for a successful operation.

notifyErrorTitle.description: Notification title for a failed operation.

notifyMultiSourceTitle.description: Notification title when files came from more than one platform.

notifyOneFile.description: Notification body for a single downloaded file.

notifyManyFiles.description: Notification body for several downloaded files.

notifyUnpacked.description: Notification body after a ZIP archive was unpacked.

errorHttp.message: Could not load the file. HTTP status: $STATUS$
errorHttp.description: Error when the ZIP archive could not be fetched.

errorEmptyZip.message: The ZIP file contains no extractable files.
errorEmptyZip.description: Error when an archive turned out to be empty.

popupTargetLink.description: Popup: link to the options page.

popupTargetWarn.message: Permission for your target folder has expired. Please renew it in the options.
popupTargetWarn.description: Popup: shown when the directory permission fell back to 'prompt'.

optionsIntro.message: By default the extension saves everything under „Downloads/STL_Downloads/“. You can pick your own folder instead – the extension then writes straight into it.
optionsIntro.description: Options page: explains what the setting does.

optionsChoose.description: Options page: button, no folder picked yet.

optionsChangeFolder.description: Options page: button, a folder is already set.

optionsRenew.description: Options page: button shown when permission fell back to 'prompt'.

optionsReset.description: Options page: button that removes the chosen folder.

optionsStateNone.message: No folder chosen – files go to Downloads/STL_Downloads/
optionsStateNone.description: Options page: status, default is active.

optionsStateGranted.description: Options page: status, folder is writable.

optionsStatePrompt.message: „$FOLDER$“ is set, but the permission needs renewing.
optionsStatePrompt.description: Options page: status, permission must be re-granted.

optionsPickFailed.description: Options page: error when picking a folder failed.

optionsWhyHeading.description: Options page: heading of the explanation card.

optionsWhyText.message: If you told Chrome to ask where to save every download, extracting a ZIP archive otherwise brings up one dialog per file. With your own target folder those dialogs disappear entirely.

optionsNote.message: Note: Chrome blocks the Downloads folder itself for this feature. A subfolder inside it works – you can create one right in the picker.
optionsNote.description: Options page: note about Chrome's blocked-folder list.
